name: What is the difference between a rough carpenter and a finish carpenter?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a rough carpenter and a finish carpenter?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rough carpenter primarily focuses on the structural elements of a building, such as framing walls, roofs, and floors. Their work forms the skeleton of a structure and is often concealed once the project is complete. In contrast, a finish carpenter specializes in the aesthetic and visible components, including trim work, cabinet installation, door and window casings, and custom built-ins. Finish carpentry requires meticulous attention to detail to achieve a polished look. At Maine Results, Inc., we offer both rough and finish carpentry expertise to handle projects from foundational structures to decorative accents.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rough carpenters build structural frameworks; finish carpenters handle visible, aesthetic elements like trim, cabinets, and custom built-ins.
